description: Na₂TeO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.77 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.63 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.74 Å. There are two inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing TeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.04 Å. In the second Te site, Te is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing TeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.05 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Te atoms to form distorted ONa₂Te₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₃Te trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Te₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Te atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Te atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Te atoms to form distorted ONa₃Te₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃Te₂ trigonal bipyramids and edges with two ONa₂Te₂ trigonal pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Te atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Te atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Te atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Te atom to form distorted ONa₃Te trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₂Te₂ trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Te₂ trigonal bipyramid.
